verdict.rationale: Remote-desktop platforms can plausibly ship official SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only a Teams API for deployment automation and audit logs. It never mentions an official SDK or client libraries, and a raw API is a building block rather than an SDK. Probes for OpenAPI specs and markdown docs all returned 404, which further suggests no machine-consumable developer tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
